title: Банкет во тьме и новый директор  (Banquet in the Dark and the New Director)

scenes.title: The Secret of Success and the Empty Safe
scenes.summary: Max praises the kitchen team, top ingredients, and service at Claude Monet, while Nagiyev panics over his stolen safe.

scenes.title: The Last Jar of Caviar
scenes.summary: Nagiyev tells Chef Barinov they are out of money for salaries and food just as corporate buyer Andrey Mikhailovich arrives.

scenes.title: Signs of Being in Love
scenes.summary: Nastya and Kostya tell Max that Katya clearly likes him and explain the three signs of a person in love.

scenes.title: The Purchase Offer
scenes.summary: Nagiyev receives a lowball offer to sell Claude Monet, and Kristina overhears and warns the kitchen.

scenes.title: A Plan to Ruin the Banquet
scenes.summary: Nagiyev announces an important banquet tonight, and Chef Barinov plots to sabotage it so the buyer backs out.

scenes.title: Culinary Sabotage
scenes.summary: The chefs pitch terrible recipes with soap, soil, and awful molecular sauce to ruin the VIP banquet.

scenes.title: Testing with a Joke
scenes.summary: Max tells Katya a terrible joke to see if she laughs, and Rodion confirms that Katya likes him.

scenes.title: No Need for a New Relationship
scenes.summary: Max tells Kostya he wants to avoid a new romance with Katya, while Chef checks the sabotaged banquet food.

scenes.title: The Electrician from Voronezh
scenes.summary: Max pretends to be fixing the electrical box to hide from Katya and ends up tampering with the fuses.

scenes.title: A Spark in the Box and the Top Shelf
scenes.summary: Chef stops Senya from stealing food, while Max finishes his fake electrical repair and tries to avoid Katya's flirting.

scenes.title: Darkness in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: The power goes out across the kitchen, and Max gets shocked when he opens the electrical panel again.

scenes.title: A Banquet for an Oligarch
scenes.summary: Nagiyev tells Chef Barinov that the banquet is actually for an oligarch who wants to invest in Claude Monet.

scenes.title: The Powerless Building
scenes.summary: Nagiyev smells the ruined banquet food in horror, and Fedya announces that the electricity is out for two days.

scenes.title: Fire in the Courtyard and Ainura's Pilaf
scenes.summary: The chefs try grilling over charcoal in the courtyard while Ainura cooks pilaf, but Fedya accidentally burns the fish.

scenes.title: By Candlelight in the Dining Room
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov gives up after the food burns, while Nagiyev stalls the hungry oligarch in the candlelit dining room.

scenes.title: The Lifesaving Pilaf
scenes.summary: Max serves Ainura's pilaf to the oligarch, who loves the nostalgic taste and praises Nagiyev.

scenes.title: The Oligarch's Confession
scenes.summary: Max credits Ainura for the pilaf, while Nagiyev discovers that the oligarch is actually bankrupt and suicidal.

scenes.title: Two Bankrupts
scenes.summary: Nagiyev convinces the bankrupt oligarch to hand over his pistol by admitting that he is broke too.

scenes.title: The New Director of Claude Monet
scenes.summary: Andrey Mikhailovich announces that Claude Monet now belongs to the restaurant chain and introduces Vika as the new director.
